ETH.note: INSA's role over land records is a project agreement, not a body's creation, response or designation.

facts.fact: AMECO reports that Ethiopia's urban ministry and INSA signed an agreement to combine legal, physical and cadastral data in one unified digital land system and to expand e-Land digital services.
AMECO reports that Ethiopia's urban ministry and INSA signed an agreement to launch a digital land registry, deploying 2D and 3D cadastral mapping and expanding e-Land services.

ETH.note: Municipal revenue is named as a goal only; no local revenue record system is described.
